chains.title: CREB3L2 binds the C allele at an unannotated intronic site; target and phenotype unproven
chains.element: Unannotated intronic sequence with no cCRE overlap.

links.claim: CREB3L2 binds the ref C allele more strongly: its own QBiC-SELEX model gives z -49.16 and effect -2.335 (ref site 100th vs alt 91.6th percentile), while a CREB3L1-mapped model gives a larger z -60.99 and effect -2.258. I chose CREB3L2 because it has an own model and a strong ref-preferring effect, but ENCODE has no ChIP-seq peak at this base in any biosample, so occupancy is unknown and this is only a binding prediction.
The variant is intronic and no cCRE overlaps it; the nearest dELS is 1,868 bp away and GERP is -3.12, so there is no epigenomic support for an active regulatory element at this base.

PELI2 is only the nearest protein-coding gene at 230.8 kb; GTEx v8 shows no significant eQTL, and the only molecular QTL is weak for ENSG00000259868 in brain (PIP 0.03), so the target gene is unproven.
CREB3L2 is expressed in MCF-7 (7.06 TPM; rank 534 of 1,626 TFs), so the cell context is permissive, though expression is modest.
There is no GWAS association for rs11629191, and the PELI2 breast-cancer literature is not variant-specific, so any breast-cancer link remains unproven.

predictions: CREB3L2 ChIP-qPCR/CUT&RUN shows enrichment at chr14:55887040 in MCF-7.
Allele-specific EMSA shows stronger binding of CREB3L2 to the C allele than the T allele.
Allele-dependent reporter activity in MCF-7 is reduced by CREB3L2 knockdown/knockout; the direction of activity is not asserted.
falsified_if: CREB3L2 does not occupy this locus in MCF-7, or an allele-specific assay shows no C-vs-T binding difference.

grades_v0.reason: QBiC-SELEX shows a strong C-allele-preferring effect (effect -2.335), but the best model is CIS-BP-mapped from CREB3L2, not CREB3L4; ENCODE has no ChIP-seq peak in any biosample and CREB3L4 occupancy is explicitly unknown. QBiC alone is at best weak.
E01/E03 show an intronic variant with no cCRE overlap and nearest dELS 1,868 bp away. This is consistent with an unannotated sequence but does not establish a functional regulatory element.

PELI2 is only the nearest coding gene at 230.8 kb. GTEx v8 shows no significant eQTL, and the Open Targets molecular QTL is for ENSG00000259868 in brain with PIP 0.03, not PELI2. No evidence ties the variant to PELI2 expression.
DepMap ACH-000019 directly shows CREB3L4 expression in MCF-7 (48.8 TPM; rank 68/1,626 TFs). This supports expression context only, not occupancy or function.

Shown: 0 of 0 occupied (0 with a strong site), 5 of 113 with unknown occupancy. Left out: 65 TFs assayed in the matching biosample and 508 assayed only elsewhere, none with a peak here. The gate (|z| > 4.05, Bonferroni over 997 models) marks a change QBiC-SELEX detects; it says nothing about occupancy. Effect > 0 means the alternate allele binds more strongly. In vitro binding only. Site strength is the better allele's best k-mer over the variant, as a percentile of the best model's k-mers; a strong site reaches the 97.5th.
